source_scope: Round 76: printed Chinese Chapters 1172–1181; Bqquge primary text reviewed through visible continuations. Vietnamese title/index comparison checked on Cơm Nguội, Hắc Hoàng Đại Đế, and Xa Lộ Sách; local numbering diverges and Xa Lộ Sách has split chapters. Vietnamese pages were used for title/index alignment only; gated bodies did not supply mechanics.

confirmed_outcomes.event: Cao Xing receives the repaired original Storm Axe as a Quasi-artifact; it lacks a core godhead and requires level 190.
Imperial resources are delivered for mass Hero promotion; rounded shipment narration differs slightly from exact altar-consumption values. 97,164 promotions are displayed.
Mass promotion completes; second War God trial ring awards Heart of Genesis and one War Plane Teleport Stone.
Heart of Genesis is fused with Bloom's Genesis Shield to create semi-artifact Genesis Shield–Anodite; its defense, linking, healing and revival field are recorded.
Abyss invasion is staged; Death Bag + Necromantic Flute are the planned means to carry Oliviaus past the rule seal.
Oliviaus is successfully carried out of the Church divine realm; 30 km Heavenly Fortune Ark stays outside the Abyss with one Destiny Judgment launcher use.
Church leadership has secretly agreed to ally against Cao; team reaches the Abyss portal. No battle loot is obtained.
Abyss entry awards 50,000,000 Exploration XP and 100,000 Prestige; Church Holy Spirit Absolute Seal trap disables spatial transport and debuffs the team.
Starfire reinforcements arrive; battle with Church begins, with no reward closure.
Abyss confrontation continues unresolved. Shield absorption, damage outputs and combat debuffs are recorded as battle observations, not loot.
Thorn Saintess Ailin Iv260 joins as midgod; population +200, prosperity +100k, human fortune +100k, loyalty 100; Gods’ Lord title buffs update.
Alphonse dies and explicitly drops Guardian Godhead (midgod), Holy Shield · Wall of the Word, and Mace · Child’s Holocaust; kill XP shown. Drop list tail is incomplete.
Abyss kill reward panels include one clear Nektar reward and later garbled/duplicated labels; aggregate inventory shows 39 Spirit Flames and 12 Mutated Overlord Souls.
Abyss Terminator SS mission reaches 100/100; settlement is deferred. The sword’s separate 100 divine-kill evolution condition remains distinct.
Rule seal fully breaks; gods awaken worldwide.
Global Age of Gods Descending event opens Faction System, with Divine Chosen allegiance, blessings and deity-control terms.

SS mission settlement lists staged chests, six semi-artifact set pieces, Flawless Divine Fire, choice Godhead, Random Divine Skill Chest, title and Prestige. Cao Xing selects Crystal Godhead; later text begins opening three chests without revealing contents by cutoff.
Source arithmetic conflict preserved: stage entries total 3,200 Divine Power Fragments; later narration claims 3,400. No silent normalization.

unresolved_conflicts: Ch1163 shipment narration uses rounded quantities while altar system display reports exact consumption values; both are retained rather than normalized.
Ch1163 shows 97,164 new Hero promotions after 120,000 gather and 25,000 are held back; preserve displayed outcome.

Vietnamese edition chapter numbering diverges materially: Cơm Nguội and Hắc Hoàng Đại Đế Ch1162 title an ice-statue goddess story, while Xa Lộ Sách local Ch1162 is a split chapter on demigod breakthrough/return to territory. These titles do not establish the Chinese printed Ch1162 story contents or item facts.
No result is shown for the Abyss battle by Ch1171; no victory/loot should be inferred.
Ch1174 Alphonse death reward line is visibly truncated after explicit Guardian Godhead, shield and mace; additional drops remain unknown.
Ch1176 post-Nektar pseudogod reward labels are garbled/duplicated; retain uncertain attribution.
Ch1175 sword evolution requires 100 divine kills; do not equate that counter with SS mission 100/100.
Ch1181 staged divine-power fragment entries sum to 3,200, but subsequent narrative says 3,400; both are preserved pending source clarification.
Ch1181 three chests are opened at the end of the chapter, but no result panel is visible before cutoff; contents unresolved.
Vietnamese edition-local chapter numbering/title arcs diverge from Bqquge printed Chinese numbering; no remapping inferred.
